prompts.actors: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art sprite sheet for a top-down 1990s fantasy strategy game. STRICT regular grid 8 columns x 9 rows, every cell identical size, transparent background, no labels, no borders, nothing outside cells. All sprites GREEN faction accents, warm skin, dark brown outlines, crisp low-resolution pixel art, NO antialiasing NO painted HD gradients. Each sprite has appearance of a 24x24 pixel drawing enlarged nearest-neighbor in its cell, ample transparent padding. Columns: front idle, front step, back idle, back step, left idle, left step, right idle, right step. Rows: 1 small peasant, 2 sturdy armored warrior, 3 massive armored colossus, 4 small crowned king, 5 sturdy crowned king, 6 massive crowned king, 7 small purple cave monster, 8 sturdy purple monster, 9 giant purple monster. Clear direction, readable feet, same lighting upper left, cohesive limited 24-color palette, flat crisp pixel clusters. Sheet exactly eight evenly spaced columns and nine evenly spaced rows. Every character completely isolated on alpha transparent.
prompts.buildings: Use case: stylized-concept. A production pixel-art building sprite sheet for top-down 1990s fantasy strategy. STRICT 4 columns by 3 rows uniform square cells, transparent background, NO text/grid/borders/shadows outside sprites. Cohesive low-resolution pixel art: each ordinary prop looks like 24x24 native pixels enlarged nearest-neighbor, castle like48x48 pixels; hard crisp pixel clusters, dark brown outline, limited24color palette, warm cream stone, GREEN faction roofs and flags, lighting upper left. Row1 columns: small square cottage; proud square medieval castle with four corner towers centered and front gate; same castle partially collapsed; same castle ruins. Row2: cave entrance with rocky rim; horizontal wooden bridge; vertical wooden bridge; wooden dam. Row3: wooden spiked barricade; bridge construction scaffold; barricade construction scaffold; rocky rubble. House fits wholly within one square tile, castle three by three tiles. Absolutely no smooth HD painting, no gradients, no antialiasing. Twelve isolated centered sprites, uniform cell positions.
prompts.terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite material sheet for top-down 1990s strategy game with cohesive true pixel art. EXACT grid 4 columns x5 rows, uniform rectangles; no labels, no grid, no frame, no margin or divider strips. Each cell entirely filled with its subject. Rows biome: forest; warm ochre desert; snow; dark marsh; violet crystal. Columns: 1 seamless ground texture (grass/sand/snow/moss/purple grass), 2 compact cluster of round-canopy trees or cactus/snowfir/mangrove/crystal plants on transparent background, 3 compact angular rocky mountain peak connected-looking foothills on transparent background (brown stone/sandstone/icy/dark/violet), 4 seamless water texture (deepblue/turquoise/icyblue/muddyteal/lilacblue). Ground and water must tile without any seams: NO bright strips, NO dark edges, NO outline around texture rectangles, uniform brightness to all four edges. Mountain and trees fit their own rectangle; solid foliage and clear silhouette. Every rectangle resembles a32x32pixel drawing enlarged nearest neighbor, hard pixel clusters, limited palette, NO HD painting, NO smooth gradients. All twenty samples occupy exact uniform grid. Transparent alpha only for tree and mountain cells, opaque full-bleed ground/water cells.
